items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Raymond Glapion. Let's see, what reel is this? Is this reel three? Reel three, yeah. Henry Glass, better known as Booker T, huh? Yeah.

ctx.x: His wife told me she's going to give it to me.
Raymond Glapion. Let's see, what reel is this? Is this reel three? Reel three, yeah. Henry Glass, better known as Booker T, huh? Yeah.

You tell him how you got your nickname? Yeah, Dr. Tudrick gave me that name, Lindsey Phil Claymore. He's ready. He just thought called you Booker T. Let's give me, well you see, he's got a name. He's got a name. He's got a name.
